note: Live per-SKU readings for scripts/check-cost-drift.mjs. Collected with scripts/browser/collect-live-costs.js on an AliExpress item page with a Canadian destination; listCad is originalPrice (rule 22), shipCad is the shipping panel's charge. Replace rows when re-read; the gate fails on rows older than seven days. RE-READ 2026-09-14 WITH skuIdStr. The late 2026-09-13 re-read of this listing keyed PRICE.skuPriceInfoMap by String(skuId), a JS number that cannot hold these 17-digit ids, so adjacent ids collapsed and the reader returned a NEIGHBOUR's price: the egg was filed at the bell's C$32.27, the nest at the pumpkin's C$34.97, and the gourd's 32cm-M at another SKU's C$65.90 (it actually reads C$36.43). Keyed by skuIdStr the listing reads egg 21.22 / bell 32.27 / nest 43.89 / pumpkin 34.97 / globe 30.34 list (sale 19.95 / 30.33 / 41.26 / 32.87 / 28.52), all stock 887-888 - i.e. within cents of the 2026-09-13 morning read. scripts/browser/collect-live-costs.js now keys by skuIdStr first.
